title: The custom properties a runtime emits for the Salt contract's shared stylesheets
description: Names only, never values: a value is the implementation's, generated from design-foundations and its brand engine. The package gate (scripts/check_salt_stylesheets.mjs) holds the list to the stylesheets: every var() they read and do not define is named here, nothing here goes unread, and `optional` is true exactly when every read carries a fallback.

source.description: Who gives the property its value. design-foundations: a role or scale rung that package names, emitted by the implementation's theme. salt: a token of Salt's own, emitted by the implementation's theme. markup: written by the markup contract on an element's style attribute. script: written by the implementation's script at run time.

ref.description: Where the name is defined: a design-foundations vocabulary or scale-shape entry, or a markup contract file.

optional.description: True when every read in the stylesheets carries a fallback, so a runtime may leave the property unset.

requiredBy.description: The dials (contract/dials.json, by id) whose rungs' values reference this property, which each lists under requires. A runtime emits it while one of them is set. It is the one way to name a property no stylesheet reads: both package gates hold the two lists to each other.

textRole.description: A design-foundations text role, which a runtime emits as five properties: --text-<id> (size), and --text-<id>--line-height, --letter-spacing, --font-weight and --font-family.

writes.description: Each property the markup writes as a var() with a <placeholder>, token or not, and what fills each placeholder: a setting, as '<fields file>#<field name>', whose options (less any in except, which write nothing) each name a token the runtime emits.
